info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: list returns every destination platform with the caller org's connection state.
get.description:
list returns every destination platform with the caller org's connection state.

Unconnected platforms are listed too, so the console can render the full catalog
from one read.

delete.summary: disconnect forgets a destination for the caller org: its KMS secrets, then its row.
delete.description:
disconnect forgets a destination for the caller org: its KMS secrets, then its row.

It is idempotent and requires org admin.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform is the destination's registry slug, e.g. meta, ga4 or tiktok.

get.summary: get returns one destination platform with the caller org's connection state.
get.description:
get returns one destination platform with the caller org's connection state.

An unknown platform slug answers 404; a known one that this org has not
connected answers its card with connected false.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform is the destination's registry slug, e.g. meta, ga4 or tiktok.

post.summary: test sends ONE synthetic pageview through the connected destination end-to-end.
post.description:
test sends ONE synthetic pageview through the connected destination end-to-end.

A send failure is reported as DATA ({"ok":false,"error":…}), not an HTTP error,
so the console renders the platform's own answer.
The event carries no PII, only a stable per-org test id, and the op requires org
admin.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform is the destination's registry slug, e.g. meta, ga4 or tiktok.

disconnected.description:
Disconnected is always true — the op is idempotent, so it also reports true
for a destination that was not connected.

platform.description: Platform is the destination's registry slug, e.g. meta, ga4 or tiktok.

account.description: Account is the operator-set label for the connected account.

category.description: Category groups the destination in the console, e.g. ads or analytics.

config.description: Config is the org's stored NON-SECRET ids for this destination.

connected.description: Connected is true when this org has a stored row for the destination.

enabled.description: Enabled is whether the org's connection currently forwards events.

fields.description: Fields are the non-secret inputs connect accepts for this destination.

live.description: Live is whether a credential resolves right now.

name.description: Name is the destination's display name.

platform.description: Platform is the destination's registry slug, the :platform path segment.

secrets.description:
Secrets are the KMS secret names this destination custodies; values are
never returned.

destinations.description: Destinations is one card per registered platform, connected or not.

error.description:
Error is the send failure, reported as DATA so the console can render it.
Absent on success.

message.description: Message is the platform's own response text; empty when it returned none.

ok.description: OK is whether the platform accepted the event.

sent.description: Sent is how many events the platform reported accepting.
